summary: Advanced the remaining CI/bootstrap slice to the point where the repo-local implementation is effectively complete and the outstanding work is now external verification. This iteration tightened the service E2E bootstrap contract so CI preview readiness now requires `.svelte-kit/output/client` in addition to `build/` and `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js`, updated the validator/docs/tests to match that real preview contract, and kept the existing preview-manifest shim coverage green. Verification passed for `node --test tests/scripts/validate-service-e2e-bootstrap.test.mjs tests/scripts/fix-sveltekit-preview-manifest.test.mjs`, `git diff --check` on the touched bootstrap/doc files, and `CI=1 VITE_API_URL=https://api.example.test VITE_NOSTR_RELAY_URL=wss://relay.example.test VITE_E2E_TURNSTILE_BYPASS=true node scripts/validate-service-e2e-bootstrap.mjs`. Most importantly, `npm run build` completed successfully in this repo and produced the full preview artifact contract now present locally: `.svelte-kit/output/server`, `.svelte-kit/output/client`, `.svelte-kit/output/prerendered`, `build/index.html`, and `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js`. The remaining required TEST-G3/TEST-G4 and CI-G1 work could not be executed further here because this sandbox rejects starting the preview server itself (`vite preview` fails with `listen EPERM` on loopback), so the remaining completion work is now environment/CI-bound rather than a missing repo-local implementation slice.
remaining_work: Run the remaining Chromium and Mobile Safari `service-quotes-*`, `service-ux-hardening*`, `service-instant-buy*`, `homepage-featured-services*`, and `tasks-services-regression-*` suites in an environment that permits starting the built preview server, or provide `PW_E2E_BASE_URL` to an externally managed built app.
Run the Chromium visual slice (`service-quotes-visual*`, `homepage-featured-services-visual*`) in that same runnable preview/CI environment after the built app is reachable.
Finish the remaining `TEST-G3` / `TEST-G4` evidence pass and address any browser-level failures that surface once those suites are run outside the current sandbox.
Verify the final `CI-G1` external requirements in real GitLab, including merge-required job behavior and `only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds`, using CI runtime variables and project API access.
required_user_action: Run the remaining Playwright service browser/visual suites in CI or another environment that allows `vite preview` (or set `PW_E2E_BASE_URL` to a reachable built app) because the current sandbox blocks loopback listens with `EPERM`.

Provide GitLab verification context for `CI-G1` if you want that gate closed from this workflow: `GITLAB_TOKEN` with `read_api`, plus `CI_API_V4_URL` and `CI_PROJECT_ID`, or run the merge-policy verification in GitLab CI itself.
